_about: Old Kerrid's emotion tags -> face blendshape weights (docs/kb/art/characters/kerrid.md §6.2). A pair is [L, R]; a scalar sets both sides of a paired shape. His rest lid_squint [0.15, 0.10] (the left eye squints a little more, the side the light came from at the gate) is added to every row. He answers with the body, not the face: most rows are small and the clip carries the beat; his feeling shows in the brow and the jaw (jaw_clench under the beard), his rare smiles through cheek_raise and lid_squint, the left cheek ahead (toward the broken side of the nose). No breath or sigh shapes, no tear layer (kerrid.md §12 Q1, Q2). Blend 0.30 s, measured, no overshoot. Tags: game/data/dialogue/emotions.json. Read by the hero stage for the M3-CHR-505 review shots; the sequencer.json face_poses entry is Cinematics'.

head_notes.neutral: watching the sea; most of Act I; nothing moves
head_notes.laugh: short and low, the head down 5 degrees (never back); Act III only
head_notes.grief: Ch15 and Ch16; held, no tear layer
head_notes.angry: Ch16 at Sefir, held, no shouting
head_notes.cold: Ch6, his back to the barge
head_notes.surprised: small; Ch5 P12 is neutral with the go_still clip, not this
head_notes.afraid: not used by the story; shipped for completeness
head_notes.determined: his battle face, the Ch8 stair foot
head_notes.guilty: Ch15, to Rhen: gaze down 15 degrees, then he makes himself look up; jaw_clench falls to 0 over Rhen's name
head_notes.exhausted: head pitch -5 degrees; Act II only
